summary: Lid opening: positions of the medial and lateral canthi relative to the iris centre (+x lateral, +y up, mm).

opening_max_radius.note: Largest distance from the iris centre to the edge of the rendered opening (the caruncle border medially). The globe plus the fornix fillet must reach it.

vertical_height.note: Vertical palpebral fissure height, MRD1 + MRD2 (Kanski normal 8-11). The reference subject is wide open (about 11.7).

provenance.source: Derived from the trace in assets/exterior/fissure.json (iris centre (1421, 875) px, 51.2 px/mm from HVID 11.8); the validator checks these values against the trace within 0.05 mm. Normal ranges: Kanski's Clinical Ophthalmology, 9th ed.
